H900.def: feminine plural active participle of «0898»; treacheries:--treacherous.

H902.def: probably of foreign origin; Bigvai, an Israelite:--Bigvai.

H903.def: of Persian derivation; Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Bigtha.

H904.def: or Bigthanad {big-thaw'naw}; of similar derivation to «0903»; Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Bigthan, Bigthana.

H905.def: from «0909»; properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of a tree, bar for carrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides:--alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.

H906.et: perhaps from (0909) (in the sense of divided fibres)
H906.def: perhaps from «0909» (in the sense of divided fibres); flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment:--linen.

H907.def: from «0908»; a brag or lie; also a liar:--liar, lie.

H908.def: a primitive root; (figuratively) to invent:--devise, feign.

H909.def: a primitive root; to divide, i.e. (reflex.) be solitary:--alone.

H910.def: from «0909»; separate; adverb, separately:--alone, desolate, only, solitary.

H912.def: probably a shortened form «05662»; servant of Jehovah; Bedejah, an Israelite:--Bedeiah.

H913.def: from «0914»; alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin:--+ plummet, tin.

H914.def: a primitive root; to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.):-- (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), × utterly.

H916.def: probably from «0914»; something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl:--bdellium.

H917.def: probably shortened for «05658»; servile; Bedan, the name of two Israelites:--Bedan.

H918.def: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from «0919»; to mend a breach:--repair.

H919.def: from «0918»; a gap or leak (in a building or a ship):--breach, + calker.

H920.et: probably from (01856) with a prepositional prefix
H920.def: probably from «01856» with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin; Bidkar, an Israelite:--Bidkar.

H922.et: from an unused root (meaning to be empty)
H922.def: from an unused root (meaning to be empty); a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin:--emptiness, void.

H923.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten)
H923.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster:--red (marble).

H924.def: (Aramaic) from «0927»; a hurry; only adverb, hastily:--in haste.

H925.et: from an unused root (meaning to be bright)
H925.def: from an unused root (meaning to be bright); shining:--bright.

H926.def: a primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously:--be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H927.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0926»; to terrify, hasten:--in haste, trouble.

H929.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute)
H929.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective):--beast, cattle.

H930.et: in form a plural or (0929), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation
H930.def: in form a plural or «0929», but really a singular of Egyptian derivation; a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile- horse:--Behemoth.

H931.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick
H931.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot:--thumb, great toe.

H932.def: an orthographical variation of «0931»; thumb, Bohan, an Israelite:--Bohan.

H933.et: from an unused root meaning to be pale
H933.def: from an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf:--freckled spot.

H934.et: active participle of the same as (0925)
H934.def: feminine active participle of the same as «0925»; a whitish spot on the skin:--bright spot.

H935.def: a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications):--abide, apply, attain, × be, befall, + besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, × certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, × doubtless again, + eat, + employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, + follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, + have, × indeed, (in-)vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, × (well) stricken (in age), × surely, take (in), way.

H936.def: a primitive root; to disrespect:--contemn, despise, × utterly.

H938.def: the same as «0937»; Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite:--Buz.

H939.def: feminine passive participle of «0936»; something scorned; an object of contempt:--despised.

H940.def: patronymic from «0938»; a Buzite or descendant of Buz:--Buzite.

H941.def: the same as «0940»; Buzi, an Israelite:--Buzi.

H942.def: probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite:--Bavai.

H943.def: a primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively):--be entangled, (perplexed).

H944.def: for «02981»; produce (of the earth, etc.):--food, stock.

H945.et: the same as (0944) (in the sense of rain)
H945.def: the same as «0944» (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month:--Bul.

H947.def: a primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively):--loath, tread (down, under (foot)), be polluted.

H948.et: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white
H948.def: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort):--fine (white) linen.

H949.def: from the same as «0948»; shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash:--Bozez.

H950.et: passive part. of an unused root (meaning to be hollow)
H950.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective):--empty.

H951.et: active part. from (01239) as denominative from (01241)
H951.def: properly, active participle from «01239» as denominative from «01241»; a cattle-tender:--herdman.

H952.def: a primitive root; to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine:--declare.

H953.def: from «0952» (in the sense of «0877»); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison):--cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

H954.def: a primitive root; properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed:--(be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-)shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

H956.def: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from «01005»; to lodge over night:--pass the night.

H958.def: a primitive root; probably to cleave:--spoil.

H959.def: a primitive root; to disesteem:--despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), + think to scorn, vile person.

H962.def: a primitive root; to plunder:--catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), × utterly.

H964.def: from «0959» and «03050»; contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine:--Bizjothjah.

H965.et: from an unused root meaning to lighten
H965.def: from an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lightning:--flash of lightning.

H966.def: from «0965»; lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine:--Bezek.

H968.def: of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Biztha.

H970.def: or bachur {baw-khoor'}; participle passive of «0977»; properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective):--(choice) young (man), chosen, × hole.

H971.def: another form of «0975»; a watch-tower of besiegers:--tower.

H973.def: a primitive root; to loath:--abhor, get hastily (from the margin for «0926»).

H974.def: a primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate:--examine, prove, tempt, try (trial).

H975.et: from (0974) (in the sense of keeping a look-out)
H975.def: from «0974» (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower:--tower.

H977.def: a primitive root; properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select:--acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

H978.def: patrial from «0980» (by transposition); a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim:--Baharumite.

H979.def: or bchuwrowth {bekh-oo-roth'}; feminine plural of «0970»; also (masculine plural) bchuriym {bekh-oo-reem'}; youth (collectively and abstractly):--young men, youth.

H980.def: or Bachuwriym {bakh-oo-reem'}; masculine plural of «0970»; young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine:--Bahurim.

H981.def: or batah {baw-taw'}; a primitive root; to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily:--pronounce, speak (unadvisedly).

H982.def: a primitive root; properly, to hie for refuge (but not so precipitately as «02620»); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure:--be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

H983.def: from «0982»; properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely:--assurance, boldly, (without) care(- less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

H984.def: the same as «0983»; Betach, a place in Syria:--Betah.

H988.def: a primitive root; to desist from labor:--cease.

H989.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0988»; to stop:--(cause, make to), cease, hinder.

H990.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow
H990.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything:-- belly, body, + as they be born, + within, womb.

H991.def: the same as «0990»; Beten. a place in Palestine:--Beten.

H992.def: from «0990»; (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form):--nut.

H993.def: probably plural from «0992»; hollows: Betonim, a place in Palestine:--Betonim.

H994.def: perhaps from «01158» (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with "my Lord"); Oh that!; with leave, or if it please:--alas, O, oh.

H995.def: a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand:--attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

H996.et: (sometimes in the pl. masc. or fem.) properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from (0995)
H996.def: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from «0995»; a distinction; but used only as a prep, between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or:--among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), + from (the widest), × in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.

H998.def: from «0995»; understanding:--knowledge, meaning, × perfectly, understanding, wisdom.
